id: title:EDsCODE:bypass environment proxies for managed trino

observations.behavior: Adds a dedicated HTTP session with proxy bypass only for PostHog-hosted Trino endpoints on port 443.
observations.posthog_connection: Connectivity reliability and network compatibility for warehouse ingestion; avoids private-IP restrictions while retaining certificate verification.
